results.title: European Commission aware of Operation Forrest Gump, reiterates "zero tolerance for corruption"
results.description: The European Commission is aware of the latest developments in Ukraine related to the Forrest Gump anti-corruption operation and has reiterated that fighting corruption is a central requirement for EU candidate countries.

results.title: 'Not a flight risk' - Durban businessman pleads for bail in human trafficking case
results.description: A Durban businessman and Rangasamy Naidoo have asked the court for bail while facing human trafficking and related charges.
